instruction: Disable the background cone animation in VLC media player's interface.

command: import pyautogui; import time; pyautogui.click({SCREEN_WIDTH_HALF}, {SCREEN_HEIGHT_HALF}); time.sleep(0.5);

metadata.explanation: Task requires agent to disable VLC's background cone animation (the traffic cone that appears when no media is playing). This is done through VLC preferences: Tools > Preferences > Interface > Display background cone (uncheck). The evaluator reads VLC's configuration file (~/.config/vlc/vlcrc) and checks if 'qt-bgcone=0' is set, indicating the background cone is disabled (default is 1/enabled).
metadata.similar_to_original: Both tasks involve VLC interface configuration. Original task captures video frame for wallpaper (context menu action), this task disables background cone (preferences checkbox). Similar difficulty with preferences navigation.
